name: Find Comment
description: Find an issue or pull request comment

token.description: GITHUB_TOKEN or a repo scoped PAT.

repository.description: The full name of the repository containing the issue or pull request.

issue-number.description: The number of the issue or pull request in which to search.

comment-author.description: The GitHub user name of the comment author.

body-includes.description: A string to search for in the body of comments.

body-regex.description: A regular expression to search for in the body of comments.

nth.description: 0-indexed number, specifying which comment to return if multiple are found
